cards.title: Boarding update
cards.body: Boarding is in progress. Please follow the crew's instructions and keep the aisle clear.

cards.title: Turbulence reminder
cards.body: We are expecting turbulence. Please return to your seat and fasten your seat belt.

cards.title: Crew assistance
cards.body: A crew member is assisting another passenger. Thank you for your patience.

cards.title: Meal service
cards.body: Meal and beverage service is in progress. Please use SoraLink to submit a service request.

cards.title: Lavatory reminder
cards.body: Please follow crew guidance when waiting to use the lavatory, and keep the aisle clear.

cards.title: Arrival preparation
cards.body: We will be preparing for arrival shortly. Please follow crew instructions and ensure your seat belt is fastened when requested.
